title.en: An Act Standardizing the Salaries of the Prosecution Staff of the Department of Justice, Provincial

text.en:
Section two of Republic Act Numbered Three thousand seven hundred eighty-three, as amended, is further amended to read as follows:
"

The Chief State Prosecutor, the Assistant Chief State Prosecutor, the Senior State Prosecutors, the State Prosecutors, and the District State Prosecutors shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines with the consent of the Commission on Appointments: Provided, That each judicial district as organized under the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Two hundred ninety-six, otherwise known as the Judiciary Act of 1948, as amended, shall have one District State Prosecutor who shall be permanently appointed thereto: Provided, further, That the District State Prosecutors shall be under the supervision of the Chief State Prosecutor.
"The salary of the Chief State Prosecutor shall be P23,000.00 per annum and for each Assistant Chief State Prosecutor P22,000.00 per annum. The qualifications and rank of the Senior State Prosecutor, State Prosecutor or District State Prosecutor shall be the same as a provincial fiscal."

Section four of the same Act, as amended, is further amended to read as follows:
"

Section one of Republic Act Numbered Forty-one hundred forty-two is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

The annual salaries of provincial and city fiscals shall be as hereinbelow fixed:
"(A) For first class province or City" Provincial or City Fiscal P22,200.00 First Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal 18,000.00 Second Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal 16,800.00 Third Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal 15,600.00 Fourth Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal 14,400.00 Fifth Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal 13,200.00 Other Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal 12,000.00 "(B) For second class province or City - Provincial or City Fiscal P21,000.00 First Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P16,800.00 Second Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P15,600.00 Third Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P14,400.00 Fourth Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P13,200.00 Fifth and other Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P12,000.00 "(C) For third class province or City - Provincial or City Fiscal P19,800.00 First Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P15,600.00 Second Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P14,400.00 Third Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P13,200.00 Fourth Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P12,000.00 "(D) For fourth class province or City- Provincial or City Fiscal P18,600.00 First Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P15,600.00 Second Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P13,200.00 Third Assistant Provincial or City Fiscal P12,000.00

In addition to such sum as may have been provided in the current Appropriations Act, there is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, such sums as may be necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, October 4, 1971.
